name: Earth-616
description: The main Marvel Comics continuity, running continuously since Fantastic Four #1 (1961).

name: Earth-295 (Age of Apocalypse)
description: Alternate timeline in which Xavier died before founding the X-Men and Apocalypse conquered North America. Age of Apocalypse crossover (1995).

name: Earth-1610 (Ultimate)
description: The original Ultimate Marvel universe (2000–2015), a modern-day reboot with younger characters.

name: Earth-811 (Days of Future Past)
description: Dystopian future first shown in Uncanny X-Men #141–142 (1981), where Sentinels rule North America.
